description: Plantage Badlaan 13-21 (BAG 1872-1881): 5.9 m fronts of ground and two upper storeys in dark red brick with yellow speklagen, two axes of round-arched windows with a yellow-brick cross hood, yellow string courses and a dentil frieze at 11.0-12.0 m, white painted eaves, one pediment dormer

match.note: Badlaan 13-21: BAG storeys 4 (3DBAG counts the dormer) but the photo has ground + 2; eaves 12.0

pediment-dormer.note: one white pediment dormer 1.8 m wide, 12.3-14.5 m

door-right.note: double door at the right axis, window left

schemaLimits: the sculpted keystone heads of 44 are plain blocks
the dormer's low side cheeks are not drawn

evidence.citation: strip.jpg gridded 40 px/m: ground window 0.9-3.2 m, string course 4.1-4.3, storey-1 windows 4.7-6.75, sill band 7.75, storey-2 8.15-10.0; yellow cross hoods 10.2-10.8; dentil 11.0; brick to 12.0 m; dormer 12.3-14.5 m

schemaLimits: the yellow cross hood is a plain arch ring; the speklagen are a band course every 0.5 m not the measured 0.2 m pitch
